steps.what: Provide biostatistical consultation, clarifying questions and explaining defensible analytical choices

tasks.design: Retain expert consultation, using existing study documents in {DOCS}. No separate repeated preparation or paperwork component is established that would support a quantified automation gain.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on the scientific question and study context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared evidence can support discussion without new software.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding uncertainty, study limitations and the client's actual decision.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining why a requested analysis may not answer the intended question.
tasks.altitude: Consultation authority and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain analysis requirements to study teams
reach.learn: Clinical collection procedures and data query workflows

evidence.claim: Biostatistical advice requires contextual scientific judgement; no task-specific labour reduction is established.

assumptions: Boundary covers consultation and its immediate evidence reading, excluding separately commissioned analyses and protocol review.
Client or colleague provides the question and existing study context; reading and clarification are in s1. No automatically structured consultation brief is assumed.
Consider native evidence access and document tools before custom code; no new system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because consultation and existing tools remain unchanged.
research_questions: Can consultation logs isolate repeat preparation from contextual advice?

already_counted.description: Clarification, evidence reading and expert advice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0. Consultation and clarification retain full time; no clerical baseline is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review research protocols and extract statistical objectives, outcomes and design assumptions

loop.purpose: Create a passage-linked protocol review worksheet
loop.input: Authorized protocol version and reviewer-defined extraction checklist
loop.output: Draft objectives, outcomes, timing and design assumptions with passage references
loop.check: Biostatistician checks every extracted meaning and omission against the original protocol, including contradictory passages
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction; missing references or ambiguity require manual reading and notes
loop.why_not_simpler: Protocol wording varies and extraction requires interpreting prose rather than copying fixed fields

steps.what: Recommend appropriate statistical analyses and document protocol limitations

tasks.design: Use an approved helper in {DOCS} to draft a passage-linked protocol worksheet. The biostatistician verifies the source reading and retains every method recommendation and communicated limitation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Protocol details must be gathered from long, inconsistently structured documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded extraction can assemble a review aid with explicit source references.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing an appropriate analysis and detecting design flaws.
tasks.human_edge: Connecting clinical meaning, estimands and statistical assumptions.
tasks.altitude: A modest reading aid leaves statistical recommendation authority unchanged.

reach.task: Identify protocol details requiring collection clarification
reach.learn: Protocol implementation and source data requirements

evidence.claim: A bounded source-linked extraction can assist protocol review, but method selection and these time assumptions remain unmeasured expert work.

assumptions: Boundary covers protocol review and analysis recommendations, excluding study execution, research design ownership and production data processing.

Biostatistician selects the exact protocol version and extraction checklist in s1, with setup and verification included. The helper produces proposed fields; no ready-made outcomes or validity flags are assumed.
Native document search and approved extraction features are tested first. Unreadable or contradictory protocols return to manual review; no recommendation is generated from unverified fields.
Only authorized study material is processed; no new source capture work is transferred to the study team.
unknowns: Approved processing environment and source permissions
research_questions: Does verified extraction reduce review time after omissions and contradictions are checked?

already_counted.description: Source reading, extraction verification and corrections

incremental.description: Checklist maintenance and review of extraction failures

approvals.approved_version: Protocol version, checked notes, recommendations and limitations; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross10 minus focal upkeep6 gives net4. Range allows ambiguous or complex protocols to eliminate the extraction benefit; recommendation time remains fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Specify data analysis algorithms, assumptions, input contracts and independent validation cases
Implement analysis algorithms and inspect the resulting code

loop.purpose: Draft an implementation of the specified algorithm
loop.input: Explicit algorithm specification, permitted libraries and test fixtures
loop.output: Candidate code with assumptions and change summary
loop.check: Biostatistician inspects mathematical correspondence, missing-data handling and edge cases, then uses independent reference results
loop.stop: One draft and one repair; any unexplained discrepancy returns to manual implementation
loop.why_not_simpler: Nonstandard algorithm implementation requires code construction beyond a fixed configuration template

steps.what: Validate algorithms independently and release the accepted implementation

tasks.design: Test native validated libraries in {DATA_PLATFORM} first. For genuinely missing implementations, a bounded helper drafts code from a biostatistician-owned specification, followed by independent validation before release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Translating a settled mathematical specification into code requires implementation effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded code drafting can assist implementation without selecting the method.
tasks.still_hard: Correct estimands, numerical behaviour and validation beyond superficial passing tests.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding the mathematical intent and detecting plausible but incorrect computations.
tasks.altitude: Retains method and release authority while reducing some implementation typing.

reach.learn: Versioning, numerical testing and data contracts

evidence.claim: Bounded code drafting may reduce implementation effort, but the proposed saving is an unmeasured scenario rather than a demonstrated biostatistical result.

assumptions: Boundary covers algorithm specification, implementation and validation; upstream source collection and routine production runs are separate.

Biostatistician produces equations, estimand, input types, units, missing-value rules, expected outputs and independent test fixtures in s1, including capture time. Missing specifications mean manual development.
Validated native libraries and configuration are tested before generated code. No model-generated test oracle is accepted as independent evidence.
No identifiable study data is required for drafting; authorized synthetic fixtures are used, and existing approved data access remains unchanged.
unknowns: Share already covered by validated libraries
Independent reference implementations and numerical tolerances
research_questions: Does checked code drafting reduce implementation time after independent numerical validation?

incremental.description: Drafting restrictions, regression examples and dependency review

approvals.approved_version: Algorithm specification, code commit, library versions and independent validation results; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=86, gross14 minus focal upkeep8 gives net6. Range allows difficult numerical cases and extensive draft repair; specification and independent validation retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine statistical project plans and timelines

steps.what: Determine technical objectives, work packages, dependencies and effort estimates for research studies
Calculate project timelines from specified dependencies, durations and calendars
Review project plans with study leads and publish agreed statistical commitments

tasks.design: Configure dependency-based timeline calculations in {PROJECT} from a biostatistician-owned planning specification. Technical objectives, effort estimates, resource negotiation and final commitments remain human decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recalculating an already specified dependency network can require repeated manual timeline editing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scheduling features can calculate dates from explicit durations and calendars.
tasks.still_hard: Estimating uncertain scientific work and agreeing realistic commitments.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising uncertainty and negotiating dependencies with the study team.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time moving dates and retain authority over statistical commitments.

reach.task: Align data delivery milestones with analysis plans
reach.learn: Collection dependencies and database readiness criteria

evidence.claim: Dependency schedules can calculate dates from explicit durations and calendars; the proposed labour saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary covers statistical project planning; study execution and ongoing data collection are separate.

Biostatistician captures objectives, work packages, durations, predecessor IDs, resource availability and deadline constraints in s1, including consultation and capture time. Existing study leads supply milestone context through normal planning exchanges.
Test native scheduling first. Missing duration or availability fields and resource conflicts return to human planning; no reliable completion forecast is inferred automatically.
Savings apply only to manual date recalculation still present today; existing automatic scheduling receives no new credit.
unknowns: Availability and reliability of planning inputs
research_questions: Does configured scheduling reduce plan revision time after input capture and stakeholder negotiation?

already_counted.description: Objectives, estimates and planning input capture
Feasibility review, negotiation and plan approval

approvals.approved_version: Objectives, work packages, resource assumptions, dependencies and timeline version; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80, gross20 minus focal upkeep8 gives net12. Zero if dates already calculate automatically; range allows uncertainty and negotiation to dominate the work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains scientific and study commitment decisions while testing bounded reading, coding and scheduling support.
reach: Align statistical requirements with clinical data managers
Package reproducible implementations with technical colleagues
role.ambitious_version: Use verified preparation gains to strengthen method validation and explain study uncertainty more clearly.
